high_level_description: The image is a combination of a quote and an illustration. The top portion contains a quote that reads, "Serenity is not freedom from the storm, but peace amid the storm." This quote is attributed to an unknown author. Below the quote, there is a smaller text that says, "Paths of Meaning." The illustration depicts a dramatic scene of a ship sailing through turbulent waters. The ship appears to be a large, multi-masted vessel with multiple sails, some of which are billowing in the wind. The ship is navigating through high waves, with one particularly large wave crashing against it.
